mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% from 3-month moving averages signal broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 0.5% below 3mo avg AND GDPC1 < 0.5% below 3mo avg
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline >0.5% from 3-month prior.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production in late-cycle expansions indicates overcapacity and slowing growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment signals improving labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 0.3% from the prior quarter's level signals potential monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises >0.3% from 3 months ago.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of declining federal funds rate and persistently high unemployment (above 7.5%) signals active monetary stimulus for economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp in 1 month AND UNRATE > 7.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines >0.1pp and UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises.
